entities.name: Kawira Mwirichia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kawira Mwirichia was a queer artist and curator from Kenya who lived in Athi River. She was a multidisciplinary artist known internationally for her kangas along with more traditional fine arts mediums such as painting, drawing, and sculpture.
